config_authority: HISTORICAL_BASELINE_CONFIG (recovered from gpu2 SIMPLE-NN bundles); NOT FINAL_PC003_CONFIG until the new workflow independently adopts each value
gate_authority: u_max<0.30 is HISTORICAL_REFERENCE_GATE, not a current source-grounded pipeline rule

loss_normalization_verified.energy_E_loss_type_1: criterion(E_/n_atoms, E_target/n_atoms) then mean over batch => PER-ATOM energy, PER-STRUCTURE averaged (each structure equal weight regardless of size)
loss_normalization_verified.force_F_loss_type_1: criterion(F_,F) reduced by torch.mean over ALL force components in batch => ATOM-WEIGHTED (large cells dominate force training)
loss_normalization_verified.lever: item['struct_weight'] (weighted flag) can re-weight per structure; recommended to offset the large-production-cell atom-weight skew
loss_normalization_verified.implication: frame fractions ~ energy-training exposure; ATOM fractions ~ force-training exposure -> see pc002_domain_counts.json exposure_by_domain

preprocessing_schema.input: str_list of structures -> per-structure pickled symmetry-function feature files
preprocessing_schema.train_val_input: train_list / valid_list text files pointing at feature pickles

label_schema.source: TEACHER (final teacher at join); this is exactly what PC002 final labeling must emit

deterministic_validation_hook: committee u-disagreement eval_committee_umax_v{5,6}.py; u_alpha=sqrt(sum_xyz Var(F over members)); gate u_max_mean<0.30 eV/A on sphere_x012
blocked_on: final teacher labels of the frozen PC002 ensemble
not_local_flag: GPU-side train command + str_list + feature pickles live in gpu2 distillation_runs/.../05_TRAINING_v6/; input.yaml is the config SIMPLE-NN reads
historical_students_status: BASELINE/REFERENCE only; none adopted as NEW_PIPELINE_CURRENT_STUDENT
